summary: Man thrown from his ATV after it struck a rock on a trail below Vista Point at Owl Creek Pass; unhelmeted, his head hit a rock and he was briefly unconscious. OMRT was paged but stood down after the patient was brought to the trailhead to await an EMS ambulance.
location: Owl Creek Pass, below Vista Point
notes: ATV crash; team stood down when patient reached trailhead for EMS.
